messages:
Ken: FYI seeing a 95th latency spike (~120ms) on small-reqs path after yesterday's adaptive-batching heuristic tweak. Rolling 1782-batch-heuristic. :eyes:
Mia: Where exactly? region/cluster/pool?
Ken: usa-west1 / ded-gpu-pool-3. Mostly seq_len <= 64 requests. Throughput looks fine, but p95 up and tail jitter.
Devon: I captured a couple of traces. KV cache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 81% for those traces. Possible bad interaction with the new queue policy + token budget packing.
perf-bot: CPU sampling summary for 1782-batch-heuristic rollout (usa-west1): 60s window, top stacks: runtime.scheduler.wait, kernel_select.evaluateKernels, batch_assembler.formBatches.
Alex: Quick diff of the change: we lowered min_batch_fill_ms from 6 -> 2 and increased token_budget_target from 1.2 -> 1.8 for small reqs. Also enabled new kernel-selection mean-latency probe if seq_len < 96.
Samir: The KV misses look correlated with the new prefix-merge behavior. When token_budget_target increased, requests were being merged into batches across different prefix hashes more aggressively, causing cache evictions earlier. Miss rate bump aligns with batch sizes increasing by ~30%.
Mia: Can you paste profiler flamegraph and a small request/response log? Also need the exact driver config you rolled out.
Devon: Flamegraph link: https://internal.perf/fg/178210 — top shows more time in kernel_select.evaluateKernels (esp quantized path) and a higher variance in assemble time.
Ken: Driver config snippet we rolled: ```yaml
selector:
  min_batch_fill_ms: 2
  token_budget_target: 1.8
  queue_policy: adaptive_priority
  kernel_probe: enable_mean_latency
```
Mia: Thanks. I think the kernel probe changed selection to favor the quantized kernel for short sequences; the quantized kernel has worse cold-start latency for micro-batches we now see. That + KV miss churn explains tail.
Alex: Re-ran local microbench: when token_budget_target >=1.6 we get batch composition that mixes prefixes; KV cache TTL is LRU per-stream with limited slots, so evictions spike. If quantized kernel also has higher per-batch setup, p95 rises.
Samir: Metric snippets: before rollout p95=18ms, p99=45ms, kv_hit=98.1%. After rollout p95=112ms, p99=230ms, kv_hit=80.6%, avg_batch_size went 1.9->2.5.
opsbot: Deployment job 1782-batch-heuristic completed at 1782099900 (canary 20%). No automated rollback triggered.
Devon: Quick repro curl (small prompt): ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"a short question","max_tokens":16}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate | jq .latency_ms
```
Mia: Proposed immediate mitigation: revert min_batch_fill_ms->6 OR reduce token_budget_target back to 1.2 in canary, and disable kernel_probe for seq_len<96. Roll forward after verifying kv_hit back to ~98%.
Ken: Agreed. I'll patch canary with token_budget_target=1.2 for usa-west1 and flip kernel_probe off. Will monitor kv_hit & p95 for 30m.
Alex: Also suggest adding a probe metric: batch_prefix_cardinality and per-batch kernel_choice so we can quickly attribute.
Samir: I'll produce a microbench harness that exercises prefix churn with same bucket distributions as prod; will run overnight and push results.
Ken: Thanks all — assigning follow-ups: Mia (root cause writeup), Samir (microbench), Alex (additional metrics), Devon (trace collection). I'll post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
